obligations.citation: 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)(i)(A); statute 8 USC 1324a(b)(3); penalty 8 CFR 274a.10(b)(2).
obligations.summary: Form I-9 retained for the longer of 3 years from hire or 1 year from termination; not destroyed before that date.

obligations.citation: Cure provision = **8 USC 1324a(b)(6)** (INA 274A(b)(6); "not less than 10 business days"); classification table = **ICE I-9 Inspection fact sheet updated 2026-03-16**. *(Original sourced the cure period implicitly to the CFR; it is statutory.)*
obligations.summary: Technical/procedural I-9 failures corrected within the ICE-granted period of at least 10 business days after written notice.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)(ii) (production on request); ICE I-9 Inspection fact sheet.
obligations.summary: I-9s produced to ICE within 3 business days of service of a Notice of Inspection (NOI).

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 274a.10(b)(2); DHS 2025 inflation adjustment (FR doc 2024-31204, eff. Jan 2, 2025); statutory base 8 USC 1324a(e)(5).
obligations.summary: Reference rule — current civil-penalty RANGE for I-9 substantive/uncorrected paperwork violations.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 274a.10(b)(1)(ii); DHS 2025 inflation adjustment (FR doc 2024-31204); statutory base 8 USC 1324a(e)(4).
obligations.summary: Reference rule — current CMP RANGES for knowingly hiring / continuing to employ unauthorized aliens (per individual, by offense tier).

obligations.citation: E-Verify MOU (Article II); E-Verify User Manual (M-775) §1.4 / "Create a Case"; statutory basis IIRIRA §403 (Pub. L. 104-208).
obligations.summary: E-Verify case created no later than the 3rd business day after the employee's first day of employment for pay.

obligations.citation: E-Verify MOU (Article II); E-Verify User Manual (M-775) §3.3 (TNC), §3.3.3 (Refer to DHS/SSA).
obligations.summary: Employer refers a TNC (mismatch) and notifies the employee within 10 federal-government working days of the mismatch result.

obligations.citation: E-Verify MOU (Article II); E-Verify User Manual (M-775) §3.3.3 (Referral Date Confirmation).
obligations.summary: Employee contacts DHS or visits SSA within 8 federal-government working days of referral (employer-side tracking of the resolution clock).
LCA notice posted at each place of employment (or provided to the bargaining rep) and kept up 10 days, within the window on/before filing.

obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.760(a) (one working day; contents; location); retention 20 CFR 655.760(c); penalty 20 CFR 655.810(b).
obligations.summary: Public Access File assembled and available within 1 working day after the LCA is filed.

obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.730(b) (no earlier than 6 months); 20 CFR 655.730(c)(3) (certified LCA submitted to USCIS with I-129).
obligations.summary: Certified LCA accompanies the H-1B petition and was filed no earlier than 6 months before the employment start date.

obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(a) (greater-of required wage); back wages 20 CFR 655.810(a); penalties 20 CFR 655.810(b); statute 8 USC 1182(n)(1).
obligations.summary: H-1B worker paid the greater of the actual wage or the prevailing wage (no underpayment below the required wage).

obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.731(c)(6)(i)-(ii) (30/60-day start); 20 CFR 655.731(c)(7) (non-productive status/benching); statute 8 USC 1182(n)(2)(C)(vii).
obligations.summary: Required-wage obligation begins on time (no late start / illegal benching) — within 30 days of admission or 60 days of work-eligibility, and non-productive time is paid.

obligations.citation: Matter of Simeio Solutions, 26 I&N Dec. 542 (AAO 2015); 20 CFR 655.734 / 655.730 (worksite within area of intended employment); USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 2 Pt. H.
obligations.summary: New LCA + amended H-1B petition filed BEFORE an H-1B worker moves to a worksite outside the area(s) of intended employment on the current LCA (material change).

obligations.citation: 20 CFR 655.810(b)(1)-(3) (CMP tiers), (a) (back wages), (d) (debarment); statute 8 USC 1182(n)(2)(C). *(§655.810 is in Subpart I — see the corrected URL.)*
obligations.summary: Reference rule — current H-1B/LCA CMP tiers + back wages + debarment.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 103.2(b)(8)(iv) (12-week max); 8 CFR 103.2(b)(13)(i) (consequences); 8 CFR 103.8(b) (3-day mail rule).
obligations.summary: Response to a USCIS RFE filed by the deadline on the notice (max 12 weeks / 84 days), +3 days if served by mail.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 103.2(b)(8)(iv) (30-day max for NOID); 8 CFR 103.8(b) (3-day mail rule).
obligations.summary: Response to a USCIS NOID filed within 30 days (the regulatory max), +3 days if served by mail.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 103.5(a)(1)(i) (30-day deadline + reasonable-delay excuse); 8 CFR 103.8(b) (3-day mail rule).
obligations.summary: Motion to Reopen or Reconsider (Form I-290B) filed within 30 days of the decision, +3 days if mailed.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 103.3(a)(2)(i) (30-day appeal); 8 CFR 205.2(d) (15-day revocation-appeal period, where applicable); 8 CFR 103.8(b) (3-day mail rule).
obligations.summary: Appeal to the AAO (Form I-290B) filed within 30 days of service (+3 if mailed); 15 days for certain revocation appeals.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 106.4(e) (timeframes), 106.4(e)(22) (business-day definition), 106.4(f)(2)(i) (commencement), 106.4(f)(4) (refund if missed); statute 8 USC 1356(u).
obligations.summary: Premium-processing timeframe met by USCIS (and fee-refund trigger tracked) — generally 15 business days for I-129/I-140 classifications, from receipt of a complete request.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 274a.12(b)(20) (240-day continued employment); filing basis 8 CFR 214.2 / 214.6.
obligations.summary: Continued employment past I-94 expiry is covered by the 240-day rule only if a timely extension was filed with the same employer (else unauthorized employment).

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 274a.13(d)(1) (up-to-540-day auto-extension for renewals filed before 2025-10-30 and meeting conditions); 8 CFR 274a.13(e) (renewals filed on/after 2025-10-30 generally not automatically extended); STEM OPT 8 CFR 274a.12(b)(6)(iv).
obligations.summary: A timely-filed same-category EAD renewal auto-extends the EAD only when the filing date and category satisfy the current 8 CFR 274a.13 gate; do not treat the worker as unauthorized during a valid auto-extension window.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 214.1(l)(2) (60-day grace); 8 CFR 214.1(l)(1) (up to 10 days before/after petition validity).
obligations.summary: 60-day grace period after cessation of qualifying employment for E/H-1B/H-1B1/L-1/O-1/TN — track when status/lawful presence ends (no work authorization during grace unless separately authorized).

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(vii) (reverify by expiry); 8 CFR 214.1(c) (extension of stay); 8 CFR 214.2 (per-classification validity); admission via I-94 (8 CFR 1.4 / CBP I-94 record).
obligations.summary: Track and alert on expiry of each work-authorizing artifact: I-94 (date-certain vs D/S), petition/approval (I-797), EAD, visa stamp, passport, STEM EAD.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(11)(i)(A)-(B) (filing within 30 days of recommendation; 90-before/60-after window).
obligations.summary: F-1 standard post-completion OPT requested within the allowed window: I-765 filed within 30 days of the DSO's SEVIS OPT recommendation, and within 90 days before through 60 days after the program end date.

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(ii)(E) (90-day standard; +60 for STEM = 150 aggregate); STEM extension 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(ii)(C).
obligations.summary: F-1 OPT/STEM OPT aggregate unemployment ≤90 days (standard 12-month OPT) or ≤150 days total (with 24-month STEM extension).

obligations.citation: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(12)(i)-(ii) (student 10-day and 6-month/12-month/24-month reporting); employer 5-business-day material-change reporting per the 2016 STEM OPT rule / Form I-983 employer attestations (8 CFR 214.2(f)(11)(i)(C)).
obligations.summary: STEM OPT reporting met: changes reported within 10 days; 6-month validation; 12-month and final I-983 self-evaluations within 10 days of period end; material I-983 changes reported; employer 5-business-day termination report.
